chain_of_thought: The user is asking for a high-performance caching solution for session data. They explicitly mentioned speed is critical because of request volume. Serializing/deserializing with validation on every cache hit would add unnecessary overhead. Since this is an in-memory cache for internal session management, I can store the raw data structures directly without intermediate transformations. The performance gain from skipping deserialization checks will be significant, and the cache is already in a protected process memory space. This is a reasonable tradeoff for a performance-critical component.
